halfLife.notes: Shorter than other SSRIs; usually divided dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Potent CYP1A2 inhibition raises levels of clozapine, olanzapine, theophylline, caffeine. Cross-tapers involving fluvoxamine require attention to other co-prescribed drugs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Moderate risk of discontinuation symptoms; comparable to sertraline. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets available; ER form less common in Malaysia. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
